entities.summary: Adam Bernard Jones is an American former professional football player who was a cornerback and return specialist in the National Football League (NFL) for 13 seasons. Known for his common emotional outbursts in public, he was nicknamed "Crybaby", due to an incident of Jones throwing a tantrum over a USB port at Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport. He played college football for the West Virginia Mountaineers and was selected by the Tennessee Titans, sixth pick overall in the 2005 NFL draft.
